tools.name: search_day_use
tools.description: Search Stayflex for hotel rooms bookable for a few hours during the day (day use, no overnight stay), with live availability and the exact price that will be charged, taxes included. Stayflex partner hotels are in France: around Paris-Charles de Gaulle airport (airport "CDG", for instance for a layo

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description: Get the details of a hotel bookable for day use on Stayflex: where it is and how to get there, star category and guest rating, the day-use packages it sells on a given date with their lowest prices (taxes included), room types and their capacity, booking rules (arrival hours, minimum notice), cancel
